'''Yixin''' is an NPC in {{Location|Rearguard Base}}. Yixin only appears during the day (08:00 - 17:00).

==Location==
{{Map Embed|Desorock Highland|Yixin}}

==Profile==
Yixin is one of the [[Midnight Rangers]] stationed at the Rearguard Base. He guards the path into [[Norfall Barrens]], warning travelers to keep their distance for their own safety.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Yixin:''' It's dangerous beyond this point. No trespassers!
:{{DIcon}} I am a Resonator.
::'''Yixin:''' Even Resonators need to be careful. The front line is intense...
::'''Yixin:''' Don't go up the slope near [[Camp Overwatch]]. It's strictly off-limits.
::'''Yixin:''' It's close to Norfall Barrens, an unpredictable territory of threats... Even powerful Resonators shouldn't underestimate it.
{{Dialogue End}}
